# Optimization contract

Bind the experiment to target ID/version/hash, healthy baseline, one primary
metric, blocking guardrails, fixtures, environment, model/tools, repetitions,
budget, candidate limit, holdout policy and rollback. Label estimates separately
from observations.

Use paired comparable runs when practical. Accept only when the target clears
its threshold and no mission, routing, authority, safety, recovery,
documentation or lifecycle blocker regresses. Keep rejected candidates and raw
evidence for learning without activating them.
